{{Quote|You can't talk to me like that. You're a clone.''"<br />"''And proud to be one. Designed to be superior. And looking at you, I can see why the Republic had to buy in a ''real'' navy. What's your problem?|Luszgoti being rebuked by Ordo Skirata|<ref name="Order 66" />}}
'''Luszgoti''' was an [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was a member of [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|COMPOR]] and was unpopular with his comrades. He objected when [[Kal Skirata]] and the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s went into a wardroom on the [[Redeemer (Republic Fleet Auxiliary Support Vessel)|''Redeemer'']], because the Nulls were [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], Kal was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], and because Kal and [[A'den Skirata|A'den]] were both [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]] cited a regulation stating that officers could invite guests into the wardroom, then head-butted Luszgoti and forced him to apologize. After apologizing Luszgoti scurried off knowing he should have never insulted any of the Null ARCs and to properly understand regulations and properly address both enlisted and officers of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Luszgoti was disliked by his fellow soldiers and even the serving droid of ''Redeemer''{{'s}} wardroom, as shown by the free ale provided to the clones by it after he left the room.<ref name="Order 66" />
